title: Hidden gradients before form: a spatial transcriptomic atlas of wheat spike patterning
content: Few sights are as emblematic of agriculture as the wheat spike—an elegant, lanceolate-shaped inflorescence that determines grain yield. The highly productive wheat spike relies on precise developmental timing; however, its architecture harbors a paradox: basal spikelets, although initiated first, are often delayed in development and remain rudimentary, failing to produce grain (Backhaus et al. 2022, 2023). The cause of this developmental imbalance has remained an open question, and understanding the gene expression patterns coordinating this crucial apical–basal axis has long been hindered by bulk tissue transcriptome approaches, obscuring regional and cellular variation.
